|---|---|

| HGNC:20079 (approved record) | **USP50** — ubiquitin specific peptidase 50, 15q21.1 |
| HGNC search for "LVM4" | **0 hits** (not an approved, alias, or previous symbol) |
| NCBI Gene 373509 | **USP50** |
| MyGene.info (uniprot:Q70EL3) | **USP50** |
| MyGene.info (symbol:LVM4) | **0 hits** |
| Ensembl/CCDS/OMIM 620563 | all map to USP50 / ENSG00000170236 |

The UniProt `GN Name=LVM4` field is inconsistent with its own HGNC cross-reference and with every other database; "LVM4" does not exist in HGNC. The encoding gene is therefore **USP50** (protein: ubiquitin carboxyl-terminal hydrolase 50 / UBP50).
